title: Privileged access attestation packages & residency-aware role scoping
creator: Ethan Morales
description: Deliver an automated evidence/reporting artifact (audit-ready ZIP) for quarterly access reviews that ties together RBAC role bindings, SSO identity assertions, SCIM provisioning events, and data residency scoping. The artifact should be producible per-customer (for Private/Dedicated) and per-region (hosted) and include signed attestations for reviewers. As part of this work we will also introduce residency-aware role scoping so privileged roles can be restricted to admining only resources in a specific region or VPC. This ticket covers design, infra changes to event capture, SCIM delta enrichment, export packaging, and a minimal reviewer UI to trigger and download evidence packages.
acceptance_criteria: Generate an evidence package containing: role bindings snapshot (with timestamps), SCIM provisioning/deprovisioning log extracts, SAML assertion hashes for sign-ins during the review period, and retention policy configuration for the tenant
Evidence package can be produced for a given date range via Console and API and results in a signed ZIP with a human-readable summary and machine-parsable CSVs
Role scoping implemented: 'region_admin' and 'vpc_admin' roles are enforced such that UI/Console and runtime RBAC checks honor residency constraints
SCIM sync includes 'entitlement_source' and 'last_provisioned_at' fields; incremental syncs (since=timestamp) return these attributes
Automated periodic job (configurable cadence) can create and store packages to a tenant-specific secure bucket and emit a dashboard event for compliance teams
Unit and integration tests covering event capture, packaging pipeline, and RBAC enforcement exist and pass in CI
Security review completed and documented for signing key usage and package storage lifecycle
implementation_plan: Design: finalize package schema and attestations with Compliance (Confluence: /docs/compliance/evidence-package-design)
Infra: add a lightweight event baker that subscribes to audit-stream and writes normalized records to a tenant events table (schema change)
SCIM: enrich provisioning events in scim-service to include entitlement_source/last_provisioned_at; expose incremental endpoint /scim/Users?since=...
RBAC: extend role model with residency scope fields; add runtime guard in authorization middleware and admin Console filters
Packaging: implement packager service that compiles CSVs, signs package with KMS-managed key, and uploads to tenant bucket with retention metadata
Console/API: add 'Generate evidence package' action and background job status page; API endpoint /v1/tenants/{id}/evidence-packages
Ops: ensure KMS key policy and bucket lockdown meet audit requirements; add smoke checks and alerting for failed package generation
Rollout: feature-flag packaging and residency RBAC behind 'compliance-evidence' flag; start with opt-in tenants and private deployments
